title: Mathematics and Logic as Non-Drifting Preconditions of Science and Moral Order
claim: Science depends on mathematics and logic, but science cannot empirically prove mathematics and logic without already using them. Mathematics and logic therefore sit beneath science as preconditions. Their non-drifting character, universality, intelligibility, and resistance to human corruption make them better classified as expressions of an ontological truth-order than as human inventions. A world where mathematical structure ceased to hold would rapidly become morally catastrophic because measurement, promise, safety, justice, accountability, and consequence would lose reliable structure.
assumptions: Scientific practice presupposes identity, noncontradiction, valid inference, measurement, quantity, and mathematical relations.
A method cannot non-circularly prove all of its own preconditions by using those same preconditions.
Mathematical and logical truths are not made true by human preference or social agreement.
Moral life depends partly on stable truth-bearing structures such as measurement, accountability, consequence, promise, and justice.
definitions: No drift: the truth of a mathematical or logical relation does not decay, mutate, or become false because humans corrupt, forget, disagree, or misuse it.
Precondition: a structure required for a practice to operate before that practice can test anything.
Category bridge: a disciplined connection between domains that preserves named relations without claiming the domains are identical in every respect.
equations: mathematical truth -> no drift under correct formulation
bridges: mathematical structure collapse -> moral catastrophe thought experiment
negative_guards: Do not claim science empirically proves mathematics or logic.
Do not claim mathematics alone proves God as a personal being.
Do not claim math and morality are identical in every property.
Do not treat category-error objections as decisive without testing whether a category bridge preserves named relations.
Do not ignore that humans can misuse mathematics even when mathematical truth itself does not drift.
kill_conditions: A non-circular empirical grounding of mathematics and logic is supplied.
Mathematical truths are shown to depend on human preference or social construction in the relevant sense.
The no-drift claim fails under precise formulation.
The moral-catastrophe thought experiment fails because moral accountability can remain fully intelligible without stable mathematical/logical structure.
The bridge from non-drifting truth-order to Logos grounding is shown to add no explanatory value over rival accounts.
